title: BigP3BCI Study E — 6x6 checkerboard (8 healthy subjects)
description: This dataset contains EEG recordings from 8 healthy participants in Study E of the BigP3BCI collection, in which a P300-based speller used a 6x6 character grid with a checkerboard stimulus paradigm. Data were recorded with 16 EEG channels at 256 Hz and annotated with Target and NonTarget events using HED. It is a MOABB-derived BIDS version of the PhysioNet bigP3BCI dataset, intended for benchmarking P300 brain-computer interface classification.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a g.USBamp (g.tec) amplifier using 16 channels placed according to the standard 10-20 montage, sampled at 256 Hz, with a 60 Hz line frequency. Participants performed a P300 speller task with visual stimulation on a 6x6 grid, with online feedback in a laboratory setting. Events were labeled Target or NonTarget, with a trial interval of 0-1.0 s.
